description: typescript-eslint 8.70.1 @typescript-eslint/no-unsafe-function-type, default options. Port of typescript-eslint's `no-unsafe-function-type` rule (https://typescript-eslint.io/rules/no-unsafe-function-type). Flags the global `Function` type used as a type reference, class implements or interface extends: a `type_identifier` reference that `resolves` to no file-local type binding.

violation.message:
The `Function` type accepts any function-like value.
Prefer explicitly defining any function parameters and return type.
